info.desc: THE TORTURED POETS DEPARTMENT is Taylor Swift’s eleventh studio album, following 2022’s extremely successful Midnights. The record was announced during the 2024 GRAMMYs, on February 4, 2024, whilst Swift was giving her speech after winning the award for the 13th time. The album was hinted towards through Taylor changing her profile picture and her website being down hours before the event. After announcing the record, she went on to post its cover, alongside possible song lyrics, on her socials. The record has 17 songs, two of them in collaboration with the American singer Post Malone and another with the British .

podcast.body: As of the recording, Taylor Swift's most recent album, released in 2024, is "filled with songs allegedly about The 1975 singer Matty Healy and actor Joe Alwyn." This demonstrates her continued use of personal relationships as inspiration for her music up to the present day, with both critical acclaim and chart success. "Her most recent album, as of this recording, 2024's The Tortured Poets Department, is filled with songs allegedly about the 1975 singer Maddie Healy and actor Joe Alwin."
